## Solution

The fitted equation is solved with a standard ODE solver: `deSolve::ode` (LSODA) in R and `scipy.integrate.solve_ivp` (LSODA) in Python. All years are integrated in one call, each with its own coefficients. The solver needs the drivers at arbitrary times, so the value of day $j$ is placed at the middle of the day, $t = j + \tfrac{1}{2}$, and values in between are interpolated linearly.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
show_fun("simulate")
```

If a library depends on the state, `terms(y, u)` is evaluated along the solution; by default the library depends on the drivers only.

## Leave-one-year-out cross-validation

Each genotype has trajectories in the years $E$. A year $e$ is predicted by a model that has not seen it:

$$
\begin{array}{ll}
\textbf{for each genotype } g, \textbf{ for each year } e \in E: & \\[2pt]
\quad \hat{\boldsymbol{\xi}}^{(-e)} \leftarrow \texttt{fit}\bigl(\mathbf{X}^{(-e)},\, \dot{\mathbf{y}}^{(-e)}\bigr) & \text{fit on the other years} \\[2pt]
\quad \bar{y}_0^{(-e)} \leftarrow \tfrac{1}{|E|-1} \textstyle\sum_{e' \ne e} y_0^{(e')} & \text{mean initial biomass} \\[2pt]
\quad \dfrac{d\hat y}{dt} = \boldsymbol{\theta}\bigl(\mathbf{u}^{(e)}(t)\bigr)^\top \hat{\boldsymbol{\xi}}^{(-e)}, \quad \hat y(t_0) = \bar{y}_0^{(-e)} & \text{predict year } e \text{ from its drivers}
\end{array}
$$

Only the drivers of the left-out year enter the prediction. The error is the root-mean-square error (RMSE, t/ha) over whole trajectories, on a fixed day, and at maturity.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
show_fun("cross_validate", "evaluate")
```

## Predicted trajectories

Held-out predictions of the sparse model, for genotypes spread over the ranking of final biomass and for selected years. Thick lines: APSIM; thin lines: model. Switch genotypes and years on and off. The right panel shows the growth rate of the same curves, estimated by centered differences.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
d3 = window.d3
Plot = window.Plot
traj = FileAttachment("data/interactive/trajectories.json").json()
shades = ["#8B1E3F", "#00A6D6", "#014E81", "#6D8B1E", "#6B7280"]
viewof genos = toggles("Genotypes", traj.genotypes, shades, [traj.genotypes[0], traj.genotypes[2], traj.genotypes[4]])
viewof years = toggles("Years", [1983, 1989, 1998, 2008], ["#374151", "#374151", "#374151", "#374151"], [1989, 1998, 2008])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const rows = genos.flatMap(name => years.flatMap(year => {
    const g = traj.genotypes.indexOf(name), s = traj.years.indexOf(year);
    return ["observed", "model"].flatMap(source => traj[source][g][s].map((y, i, a) => ({
      name, year, source, das: traj.das0 + i, y, rate: i > 0 && i < a.length - 1 ? (a[i + 1] - a[i - 1]) / 2 : null})));
  }));
  const panel = (key, label, domain) => Plot.plot({
    width: 262, height: 70 + 120 * years.length, marginLeft: 42, marginRight: 8,
    style: {fontSize: "10px"},
    x: {label: "days after sowing"},
    y: {label, domain},
    fy: {label: null, domain: years, tickFormat: d => d},
    color: {domain: traj.genotypes, range: shades},
    marks: [
      Plot.line(rows.filter(d => d.source === "observed" && d[key] !== null),
        {x: "das", y: key, fy: "year", z: "name", stroke: "name", strokeWidth: 4, strokeOpacity: 0.3}),
      Plot.line(rows.filter(d => d.source === "model" && d[key] !== null),
        {x: "das", y: key, fy: "year", z: "name", stroke: "name", strokeWidth: 1.4})
    ]
  });
  return html`<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0.5rem">${panel("y", "biomass (t/ha)", [0, 18])}${panel("rate", "growth rate (t/ha/day)", [0, 0.4])}</div>`;
}
```

## Python

```python
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

g, s = np.indices(tr.nend.shape)
obs, pred = tr.Y[g, s, tr.nend].ravel(), P[g, s, tr.nend].ravel()
year = np.tile(tr.years, len(tr.genotypes))
rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((obs - pred) ** 2))

colours = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list("dgxe", [BLUE, CYAN, BURGUNDY])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.6, 4))
ax.plot([obs.min(), obs.max()], [obs.min(), obs.max()], color="#9CA3AF", lw=0.8)
points = ax.scatter(obs, pred, c=year, s=4, alpha=0.5, cmap=colours,
                    linewidths=0)
ax.text(0.04, 0.95, f"RMSE {rmse:.2f} t/ha", transform=ax.transAxes, va="top")
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.set_xlabel("APSIM biomass at maturity (t/ha)")
ax.set_ylabel("predicted biomass (t/ha)")
fig.colorbar(points, label="year", shrink=0.8)
fig.tight_layout()
```

:::

```{r}
#| label: 05-3-run
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 5
last <- cbind(as.vector(row(tr$nend)), as.vector(col(tr$nend)),
              as.vector(tr$nend) + 1)
d <- data.frame(obs = tr$Y[last], pred = P[last],
                year = tr$years[as.vector(col(tr$nend))])
rmse <- sqrt(mean((d$obs - d$pred)^2))

ggplot(d, aes(obs, pred, colour = year)) +
  geom_abline(colour = dgxe[["grey"]], linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = min(d$obs), y = max(d$pred), hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           size = 3.4, label = sprintf("RMSE %.2f t/ha", rmse)) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = c(dgxe[["blue"]], dgxe[["cyan"]],
                                     dgxe[["burgundy"]]),
                         name = "year") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "APSIM biomass at maturity (t/ha)",
       y = "predicted biomass (t/ha)") +
  theme_dgxe() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

## Number of terms

For a library that also contains products of pairs of drivers (`pairs = TRUE`, 136 terms), the held-out error of backward elimination (every twentieth genotype) as a function of the number of terms is:

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## R

```{r}
#| label: 05-7
#| ref.label: 05-7-run
#| eval: false
```

## Python

```python
Theta2 = make_library(drv, pairs=True)
genotypes = tr.genotypes[::20]
ks = [4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 36, 60, 136]

def rmse_for(k):
    def fit(X, dy):
        return fit_subset(X, dy, k, "backward")
    return evaluate(cross_validate(Theta2, tr, fit, genotypes),
                    tr)["trajectory_rmse"]

by_k = pd.DataFrame({"k": ks, "rmse": [rmse_for(k) for k in ks]})
```

:::

```{r}
#| label: 05-7-run
#| echo: false
Theta2 <- make_library(drv, pairs = TRUE)
genotypes <- tr$genotypes[seq(1, 199, by = 20)]
ks <- c(4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 36, 60, 136)

by_k <- cached("rmse_vs_k.rds", data.frame(k = ks, rmse = sapply(ks, function(k) {
  fit <- function(X, dy) fit_subset(X, dy, k, "backward")
  evaluate(cross_validate(Theta2, tr, fit, genotypes), tr)[[1]]
})))
```
